name: Do I need to schedule the electrical work before drywall, insulation, and cabinets go in?
description: Yes. Electrical rough-in should be completed and inspected before walls and finish materials close it up.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to schedule the electrical work before drywall, insulation, and cabinets go in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases the electrician should be coordinated before drywall, insulation, cabinet installation, and any finish work begins. Rough-in, inspection, and trim-out all depend on the right sequence, and electrical work should not be buried before it is inspected. For Denver-metro remodels, the safest approach is to confirm handoff points in writing before each trade starts.
